title: The AI stack in UK goods exports
source: HMRC Overseas Trade Statistics; ONS UK trade in goods by CPA (MQ10); ukmacro calculations
note: Upper bound: whole product groups, which contain AI and non-AI products (ONS has not yet published AI shares). Layers nest from narrowest to broadest; the top of each bar is the ONS extended goods tier (CPA 26-28). IMF basket and other AI products from HMRC by commodity code; the rest is ONS MQ10 (balance of payments basis, seasonally adjusted) minus those, so it absorbs small differences between the sources. Other AI products exclude codes created in 2022 (sensors, handling robots, drones).
